schemas.ddl:
CREATE TABLE "Conference"
(
    Id        INTEGER
        constraint Conference_pk
            primary key,
    ShortName TEXT,
    FullName  TEXT,
    HomePage  TEXT
)

CREATE TABLE "Journal"
(
    Id        INTEGER
        constraint Journal_pk
            primary key,
    ShortName TEXT,
    FullName  TEXT,
    HomePage  TEXT
)

CREATE TABLE Paper
(
    Id           INTEGER
            primary key,
    Title        TEXT,
    Year         INTEGER,
    ConferenceId INTEGER,
    JournalId    INTEGER,
    Keyword      TEXT,
    foreign key (ConferenceId) references Conference(Id),
    foreign key (JournalId) references Journal(Id)
)

CREATE TABLE book_language
(
    language_id   INTEGER
            primary key,
    language_code TEXT,
    language_name TEXT
)

CREATE TABLE publisher
(
    publisher_id   INTEGER
            primary key,
    publisher_name TEXT
)

CREATE TABLE book
(
    book_id          INTEGER
            primary key,
    title            TEXT,
    isbn13           TEXT,
    language_id      INTEGER,
    num_pages        INTEGER,
    publication_date DATE,
    publisher_id     INTEGER,
    foreign key (language_id) references book_language(language_id),
    foreign key (publisher_id) references publisher(publisher_id)
)

CREATE TABLE genre
(
    id         INTEGER not null
            primary key,
    genre_name TEXT default NULL
)

CREATE TABLE game
(
    id        INTEGER not null
            primary key,
    genre_id  INTEGER          default NULL,
    game_name TEXT default NULL,
    foreign key (genre_id) references genre(id)
)

CREATE TABLE platform
(
    id            INTEGER not null
            primary key,
    platform_name TEXT default NULL
)

CREATE TABLE publisher
(
    id             INTEGER not null
            primary key,
    publisher_name TEXT default NULL
)

CREATE TABLE game_publisher
(
    id           INTEGER not null
            primary key,
    game_id      INTEGER default NULL,
    publisher_id INTEGER default NULL,
    foreign key (game_id) references game(id),
    foreign key (publisher_id) references publisher(id)
)

CREATE TABLE game_platform
(
    id                INTEGER not null
            primary key,
    game_publisher_id INTEGER default NULL,
    platform_id       INTEGER default NULL,
    release_year      INTEGER default NULL,
    foreign key (game_publisher_id) references game_publisher(id),
    foreign key (platform_id) references platform(id)
)

CREATE TABLE semester (
    semester_id       INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    academic_year     INT NOT NULL,
    semester_code     VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    start_date_key    INT NOT NULL,
    end_date_key      INT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE department (
    department_id     INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    department_code   VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    department_name   VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE teacher (
    teacher_id        INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    teacher_no        VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    teacher_name      VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    department_id     INT NOT NULL,
    gender_code       CHAR(1),
    phone             VARCHAR(20),
    region_id         INT,
    FOREIGN KEY (department_id) REFERENCES department(department_id)
)

CREATE TABLE class (
    class_id          INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    class_code        VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    class_name        VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    department_id     INT NOT NULL,
    grade_year        INT,
    FOREIGN KEY (department_id) REFERENCES department(department_id)
)

CREATE TABLE student (
    student_id            INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    student_no            VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    student_name          VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    gender_code           CHAR(1),
    academic_level_code   VARCHAR(20),
    department_id         INT NOT NULL,
    class_id              INT NOT NULL,
    home_region_id        INT,
    student_status_code   VARCHAR(20),
    admit_date_key        INT,
    FOREIGN KEY (department_id) REFERENCES department(department_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (class_id) REFERENCES class(class_id)
)

CREATE TABLE course (
    course_id         INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    course_code       VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    course_name       VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
    department_id     INT NOT NULL,
    teacher_id        INT NOT NULL,
    credit            DECIMAL(3,1),
    course_type       VARCHAR(20),
    max_score         INT,
    FOREIGN KEY (department_id) REFERENCES department(department_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (teacher_id) REFERENCES teacher(teacher_id)
)

CREATE TABLE enrollment (
    enrollment_id     INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,

entity_profiles.title: 教师

entity_profiles.title: 学生
entity_profiles.notes: 确认同一学号是否跨年对应同一人，以及毕业/离校学生是否应纳入默认查询。先选择身份记录再筛选学籍、性别、地区，还是查询历史状态？

entity_profiles.title: 课程
entity_profiles.notes: 确认课程是稳定定义还是每年开课实例。学分、任课教师、max_score可能改变；历史成绩折算应使用对应年度课程属性。

entity_profiles.title: 班级
entity_profiles.notes: 确认班级代码是否跨年复用。grade_year是入学年份条件，与年度库选择分别判断。

entity_profiles.title: 学期
entity_profiles.notes: 确认学期代码唯一范围、两年库是否重复保存同一学期，以及semester_id=1在两库是否指同一学期。不得仅按本地自增编号跨年去重。

entity_profiles.title: 选课记录
entity_profiles.candidate_key: 业务学生身份 + 课程身份 + 学期身份；可能还需重修/选课批次
entity_profiles.notes: 选课是历史事件，不等于学生快照。跨学期选课不能按学生编号合并为一条；确认重修、重复选课、退课与补录的保留和覆盖规则。

entity_profiles.title: 成绩分项
entity_profiles.candidate_key: 业务选课身份 + exam_item；是否包含score_date_key需确认
entity_profiles.notes: 确认补考、重考、补录是新增事件还是修订原分项。先映射年度内enrollment关联，再判断更新优先级，不用exam_score_id直接跨年连接。

entity_profiles.title: 院系（关联维度）
entity_profiles.notes: 问题中的院系编号可能是年度本地ID。合并跨年数据前须确认ID一致性或按业务代码映射。
